question: How did recorded international and domestic intercity event volumes expand alongside geographic connectivity?
claim: Event volume and positive directed-route counts increased, while mean events per positive route also increased across the four periods.

panels.a: Observed global international events versus a reference holding baseline mean events per positive country-pair route constant.
panels.b: Four source-country coverage distributions connected by shape-preserving monotone cubic interpolation in log10 threshold space. Preserve all 215 original integer thresholds and empirical percentages per year exactly; show no extra markers.
panels.c: Observed global domestic intercity events versus a reference holding baseline mean events per positive city-pair route constant.
panels.d: Keep all original domestic source-city threshold values and connecting solid lines on a logarithmic threshold axis with integer power-of-ten ticks and no decimal labels.
panels.e: One equal-sized point per unique domestic destination city, grouped by country and coloured by first positive domestic inflow recorded in the study window.

reference: F_ref(t) = [F(t0) / L(t0)] * L(t), with t0 the first year and L the number of positive directed routes. This is a descriptive benchmark, not a database-coverage correction or causal counterfactual.
encoding: Observed a/c counts: bold red 2-pt lines and 4.5-pt annual dots. References: blue lines and 4.5-pt annual dots. No shading. All d curves use solid lines, with colour identifying year.
data_integrity: Retain every cleaned event, country, city and empirical threshold. b interpolates only between the existing exact empirical values; no extrapolation, averaging, statistical refit or change in source data. d data unchanged.

background_grid.placement: Continue both the major-tick intervals and their midpoint guides beyond the outermost labelled ticks, stopping at plot limits. Use display-space intervals on logarithmic axes.
background_grid.boundary_text_policy: No added perimeter. Keep all interior grid guides clear of text and legend footprints.
background_grid.boundary_rule: No added perimeter; continue regular interior major and midpoint grids up to plot limits.
